With $a = L/v$ and $b = T_f$, expanding $e^{-a/\tau}$ and $e^{b/\tau}$ gives $p^\star(\tau) = \tau\big[(2 - e^{-a/\tau})e^{b/\tau} - 1\big] = a + b + \big(ab + \tfrac{b^2}{2} - \tfrac{a^2}{2}\big)/\tau + O(\tau^{-2})$, so $p^\star(\tau) \to L/v + T_f = 6$ from below ($5.93$ at $\tau = 100$). The discount time constant cannot be chosen to fight the exponential alone; it is also a task parameter.

    (hdim : finrank ℝ E=Fintype.card (Fin n)) (vectors : Fin n → E)
    (hindependent : LinearIndependent ℝ vectors) (i : Fin n) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_factor_is_lower_triangular
before.statement:
theorem actual_gram_factor_is_lower_triangular
    (hdim : finrank ℝ E=Fintype.card (Fin n)) (vectors : Fin n → E) :
    (triangularGramFactor hdim vectors).IsLowerTriangular

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_factor_product
before.statement:
theorem actual_gram_factor_product
    (hdim : finrank ℝ E=Fintype.card (Fin n)) (vectors : Fin n → E) :
    triangularGramFactor hdim vectors*(triangularGramFactor hdim vectors)ᵀ=
      Matrix.gram ℝ vectors

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_gram_schmidt_diagonal_is_norm
before.statement:
theorem actual_gram_schmidt_diagonal_is_norm (vectors : Fin n → E)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_definite_leading_principal_minors_are_positive

theorem actual_positive_definite_leading_principal_minors_are_positive
    (matrix : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hpositive : matrix.PosDef)

    0 < (matrix.submatrix (Fin.castLE hsize) (Fin.castLE hsize)).det

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_definite_matrix_has_cholesky
before.statement:
theorem actual_positive_definite_matrix_has_cholesky
    (matrix : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hpositive : matrix.PosDef) :
    ∃ lower : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      lower.IsLowerTriangular ∧ (∀ i, 0 < lower i i) ∧ matrix=lower*lowerᵀ

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesCholesky.actual_positive_triangular_factor_implies_positive_definite
before.statement:
theorem actual_positive_triangular_factor_implies_positive_definite

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.actual_linear_activation_has_declared_slope

theorem actual_linear_activation_has_declared_slope (alpha beta slope : ℝ)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.scalar_qc_iff_realizable_actual_increment
before.statement:
theorem scalar_qc_iff_realizable_actual_increment (alpha beta input hidden : ℝ)
    (hab : alpha ≤ beta) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesChords.unit_interval_qc_is_scalar_product

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_gap_has_euclidean_increment_bound
before.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_gap_has_euclidean_increment_bound
    {X : Type*} (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) :
    |(actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)-
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass)| ≤
    actualClassPairGain weight firstClass secondClass*‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_gap_increment_is_weighted_feature_increment
before.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_gap_increment_is_weighted_feature_increment
    {X : Type*} (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) :
    (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)-
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass)=
    ∑ coordinate,(weight firstClass coordinate-weight secondClass coordinate)*
      (feature first coordinate-feature second coordinate)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_class_pair_margin_preserves_order_within_ratio_radius
before.statement:
theorem actual_class_pair_margin_preserves_order_within_ratio_radius
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ first second,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖ ≤ dist first second)
    (firstClass secondClass : O) (first second : X) (pairGain : ℝ) (hgain : 0 < pairGain)
    (hbound : actualClassPairGain weight firstClass secondClass ≤ pairGain)
    (hradius : dist first second <
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first firstClass-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first secondClass)/pairGain) :
    actualClassLogits weight bias feature second secondClass < actualClassLogits weight bias feature second firstClass

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesClassificationCertificate.actual_one_vs_rest_radius_preserves_unique_prediction
before.statement:
theorem actual_one_vs_rest_radius_preserves_unique_prediction
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (weight : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (feature : X → I → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ first second,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (feature first-feature second)‖ ≤ dist first second)
    (winner : O) (pairGain : O → ℝ) (first second : X)
    (hgain : ∀ other,other≠winner → 0 < pairGain other)
    (hbound : ∀ other,other≠winner → actualClassPairGain weight winner other ≤ pairGain other)
    (hradius : ∀ other,other≠winner → dist first second <
      (actualClassLogits weight bias feature first winner-actualClassLogits weight bias feature first other)/pairGain other) :
    ∀ other,other≠winner → actualClassLogits weight bias feature second other < actualClassLogits weight bias feature second winner

    (∀ multiplier : K → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ multiplier k) →
      0 ≤ diagonalQC alpha beta multiplier input hidden) ↔
    ∃ slope : K → ℝ, (∀ k, alpha ≤ slope k ∧ slope k ≤ beta) ∧
      hidden=Matrix.diagonal slope *ᵥ input

    (multiplier : K → ℝ) (hmultiplier : ∀ k, 0 ≤ multiplier k) (first second : K → ℝ) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDiagonalQC.diagonal_qc_matrix_is_stated_block

theorem diagonal_qc_matrix_is_stated_block (alpha beta : ℝ) (multiplier : K → ℝ) :
    diagonalQCMatrix alpha beta multiplier=
      Matrix.fromBlocks ((-2*alpha*beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((alpha+beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((alpha+beta) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)
        ((-2:ℝ) • Matrix.diagonal multiplier)

theorem actual_connected_dynamic_cascade_has_every_finite_weighted_energy_bound
    (channels states : ℕ → ℕ)
    (layer : ∀ stage,actualFiniteDynamicLayer (states stage) (channels stage) (channels (stage+1)))
    (weight : ∀ stage,Matrix (Fin (channels stage)) (Fin (channels stage)) ℝ)
    (hstorage : ∀ stage,(layer stage).P.PosSemidef)
    (hactivation : ∀ stage,slopeRestricted (layer stage).activation 0 1)
    (hmultiplier : ∀ stage coordinate,0 ≤ (layer stage).multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : ∀ stage,(actualLayerCertificate (layer stage).A (layer stage).B
      (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).P (weight stage) (weight (stage+1))
        (layer stage).multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (states stage) → ℝ)
    (firstInput secondInput : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (channels stage) → ℝ)
    (hfirstState : ∀ stage time,firstState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondState : ∀ stage time,secondState stage (time+1)=

    (hinitial : ∀ stage,firstState stage 0=secondState stage 0)
    (hfirstConnection : ∀ stage time,firstInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondConnection : ∀ stage time,secondInput (stage+1) time=

        (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))

      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic (weight 0) (firstInput 0 time-secondInput 0 time)

before.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_cascade_euclidean_output_bound_from_source_endpoint_weights
    {I O : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype O] [DecidableEq I]
    (W : Matrix O I ℝ) (bias : O → ℝ) (weight : Matrix I I ℝ)
    (hweight : (weight-Wᵀ*W).PosSemidef) (first second : ℕ → I → ℝ)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (sourceFirst sourceSecond : ℕ → J → ℝ)
    (gain : ℝ) (horizon : ℕ)
    (hcascade : (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic weight (first time-second time)) ≤
      ∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,quadratic ((gain^2) • (1 : Matrix J J ℝ))
        (sourceFirst time-sourceSecond time)) :
    (∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
      ((W *ᵥ first time+bias) coordinate-(W *ᵥ second time+bias) coordinate)^2) ≤
      gain^2*(∑ time ∈ Finset.range horizon,∑ coordinate,
        (sourceFirst time coordinate-sourceSecond time coordinate)^2)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesDynamicLayer.actual_layer_certificate_quadratic_identity
before.statement:
theorem actual_layer_certificate_quadratic_identity (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ)
    (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ) (P : Matrix S S ℝ)
    (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ) (multiplier : O → ℝ)
    (state : S → ℝ) (input : I → ℝ) (hidden : O → ℝ) :
    quadratic (actualLayerCertificate A B C D P Xin Xout multiplier)
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim state input) hidden)=
      quadratic P state-quadratic P (A *ᵥ state+B *ᵥ input)+
      quadratic Xin input-quadratic Xout hidden-
      ∑ coordinate, multiplier coordinate*
        (2*((C *ᵥ state+D *ᵥ input) coordinate)*(hidden coordinate)-2*(hidden coordinate)^2)

before.statement:
theorem actual_dynamic_layer_activation_increment_satisfies_qc

    (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1) (multiplier : O → ℝ)
    (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (firstState secondState : S → ℝ) (firstInput secondInput : I → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ coordinate,multiplier coordinate*
      (2*((C *ᵥ (firstState-secondState)+D *ᵥ (firstInput-secondInput)) coordinate)*
        ((actualLayerHidden C D bias activation firstState firstInput-
          actualLayerHidden C D bias activation secondState secondInput) coordinate)-
        2*((actualLayerHidden C D bias activation firstState firstInput-
          actualLayerHidden C D bias activation secondState secondInput) coordinate)^2)

theorem actual_dynamic_layer_lmi_implies_storage_dissipation
    (A : Matrix S S ℝ) (B : Matrix S I ℝ) (C : Matrix O S ℝ) (D : Matrix O I ℝ)
    (P : Matrix S S ℝ) (Xin : Matrix I I ℝ) (Xout : Matrix O O ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ) (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)
    (multiplier : O → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : (actualLayerCertificate A B C D P Xin Xout multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : S → ℝ) (firstInput secondInput : I → ℝ) :
    quadratic P (actualLayerNextState A B firstState firstInput-
      actualLayerNextState A B secondState secondInput)-quadratic P (firstState-secondState) ≤

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesEllipsoidOffset.actual_affine_interval_containment_iff_the_smaller_margin_schur_lmi

    actualFIRResponse currentGain delayedGain input 0=currentGain*input 0 ∧

theorem discounted_bellman_upper {X U : Type*} (state : ℕ → X) (action : ℕ → U)
    (transition : X → U → X) (reward : X → U → ℝ) (V : X → ℝ)
    (gamma : ℝ) (hg : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (hdynamics : ∀ n, state (n+1)=transition (state n) (action n))
    (hbellman : ∀ n, reward (state n) (action n)+gamma*V (transition (state n) (action n)) ≤ V (state n)) :
    ∀ n, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, gamma^k*reward (state k) (action k))+
      gamma^n*V (state n) ≤ V (state 0)

    (hcertificate : ∀ stage,stage<depth → (actualLayerCertificate (layer stage).A (layer stage).B
      (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).P (weight stage) (weight (stage+1))
        (layer stage).multiplier).PosSemidef)
    (firstState secondState : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (states stage) → ℝ)
    (firstInput secondInput : ∀ stage,ℕ → Fin (channels stage) → ℝ)
    (hfirstState : ∀ stage,stage<depth → ∀ time,firstState stage (time+1)=

    (hsecondState : ∀ stage,stage<depth → ∀ time,secondState stage (time+1)=
      actualLayerNextState (layer stage).A (layer stage).B (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))
    (hinitial : ∀ stage,stage<depth → firstState stage 0=secondState stage 0)
    (hfirstConnection : ∀ stage,stage<depth → ∀ time,firstInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (firstState stage time) (firstInput stage time))
    (hsecondConnection : ∀ stage,stage<depth → ∀ time,secondInput (stage+1) time=
      actualLayerHidden (layer stage).C (layer stage).D (layer stage).bias (layer stage).activation
        (secondState stage time) (secondInput stage time))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesFullyConnectedLayer.actual_fully_connected_certificate_quadratic_identity

      ⟨fun y => gaussianReal (C ⬝ᵥ ((K+lambda • (1 : Matrix I I ℝ))⁻¹ *ᵥ y))

theorem actual_gaussian_posterior_measures_from_joint_and_sequential_formulas_are_identical
    (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (d c y : I → ℝ) (v r b z : ℝ) (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hs : innovationVariance A d v≠0) (hSymm : Aᵀ=A) :
    gaussianReal
      (((augmented A d v)⁻¹*ᵥ(Sum.elim c (fun _ => r))) ⬝ᵥ (Sum.elim y (fun _ => z)))
      (b-((augmented A d v)⁻¹*ᵥ(Sum.elim c (fun _ => r))) ⬝ᵥ (Sum.elim c (fun _ => r))).toNNReal=
    gaussianReal
      (c ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹*ᵥy)+lastWeight A d c v r*(z-d ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹*ᵥy)))
      (b-c ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹*ᵥc)-(innovationCross A d c r)^2/innovationVariance A d v).toNNReal

theorem actual_general_roesser_cross_matrix_action
    (verticalRadius horizontalRadius : ℕ) (kernel : ℕ → ℕ → Matrix O I ℝ)
    (input : ℤ → ℤ → I → ℝ) (vertical horizontal : ℤ) (row : Fin verticalRadius × O) :

      actualGeneralHorizontalState horizontalRadius input vertical horizontal) row=

before.statement:
theorem actual_general_roesser_output_is_full_kernel_convolution
    (verticalRadius horizontalRadius : ℕ) (kernel : ℕ → ℕ → Matrix O I ℝ)
    (bias : O → ℝ) (input : ℤ → ℤ → I → ℝ) (vertical horizontal : ℤ) :
    actualFirstDelaySelection verticalRadius*ᵥactualGeneralVerticalState verticalRadius horizontalRadius kernel input vertical horizontal+
      actualGeneralRoesserC2 horizontalRadius kernel*ᵥactualGeneralHorizontalState horizontalRadius input vertical horizontal+
      kernel 0 0*ᵥinput vertical horizontal+bias=
        actualGeneralZeroPaddedConvolution verticalRadius horizontalRadius kernel bias input vertical horizontal

theorem actual_general_roesser_output_recovers_source_natural_image_convolution

    (bias : O → ℝ) (image : ℕ → ℕ → I → ℝ) (vertical horizontal : ℕ) :
    actualFirstDelaySelection verticalRadius*ᵥactualGeneralVerticalState verticalRadius horizontalRadius kernel
      (actualNaturalImageZeroExtension image) vertical horizontal+
      actualGeneralRoesserC2 horizontalRadius kernel*ᵥactualGeneralHorizontalState horizontalRadius
        (actualNaturalImageZeroExtension image) vertical horizontal+
      kernel 0 0*ᵥactualNaturalImageZeroExtension image vertical horizontal+bias=
        actualFiniteSourceConvolution verticalRadius horizontalRadius kernel bias image vertical horizontal

before.statement:
theorem actual_reached_state_has_a_constructed_unique_future_ode_solution
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (field : E→E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hL : LipschitzWith L field)
    (original : ℝ→E) (time : ℝ) (htime : 0 ≤ time)
    (horiginal : ∀ t,0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt original (field (original t)) t) :
    ∃ restarted : ℝ→E,
      restarted 0=original time ∧
      (∀ t,0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt restarted (field (restarted t)) t) ∧
      (∀ other : ℝ→E,other 0=original time →
        (∀ t,0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt other (field (other t)) t) →
          ∀ t,0 ≤ t → other t=restarted t) ∧
      (∀ t,restarted t=original (time+t))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeBarrierGlobal.actual_compact_barrier_superlevel_set_has_a_global_safe_solution_from_every_safe_state
before.statement:
theorem actual_compact_barrier_superlevel_set_has_a_global_safe_solution_from_every_safe_state
    (F : E → E) (D : Set E) (h : E → ℝ) (alpha : ℝ → ℝ) (J : Set ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hf : LocallyLipschitzOn D F) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h D)
    (hm : MonotoneOn alpha J) (ha0 : alpha 0 = 0) (hJ0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ J)
    (hhJ : MapsTo h D J)
    (hbarrier : ∀ z ∈ D, -alpha (h z) ≤ fderiv ℝ h z (F z))
    (hcompact : IsCompact {z | 0 ≤ h z}) (hsubset : {z | 0 ≤ h z} ⊆ D)
    (x₀ : E) (hx₀ : 0 ≤ h x₀) :
    ∃ x : ℝ → E, x 0 = x₀ ∧ (∀ t ≥ 0, 0 ≤ h (x t)) ∧

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeKernelConfidenceMeasurable.actual_finite_query_kernel_posterior_mean_variance_and_determinant_are_measurable
before.statement:
theorem actual_finite_query_kernel_posterior_mean_variance_and_determinant_are_measurable
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (kernel : X → X → ℝ) (lambda : ℝ)
    (query : ℕ → Ω → X) (hq : ∀ i, Measurable (query i))
    (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (f : X → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    Measurable (fun omega => actualKernelMeanAt kernel lambda (fun i => query i omega)
      f (fun i => Y i omega) n x) ∧
    Measurable (fun omega => actualKernelVarianceAt kernel lambda (fun i => query i omega) n x) ∧
    Measurable (fun omega => (1 + lambda⁻¹ • actualKernelPastGram kernel
      (fun i => query i omega) n).det)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeKernelConfidenceMeasurable.actual_predictable_finite_kernel_posterior_band_event_is_measurable
before.statement:
theorem actual_predictable_finite_kernel_posterior_band_event_is_measurable
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ)
    (kernel : X → X → ℝ) (lambda : ℝ) (query : ℕ → Ω → X)
    (hq : ∀ i, Measurable[F i] (query i))
    (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F (i + 1)] (Y i))
    (f : X → ℝ) (B R delta : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {omega | ∀ n x,
      |f x - actualKernelMeanAt kernel lambda (fun i => query i omega)
          f (fun i => Y i omega) n x| ≤
        (Real.sqrt B + R / Real.sqrt lambda *
          Real.sqrt (Real.log (1 + lambda⁻¹ • actualKernelPastGram kernel
            (fun i => query i omega) n).det + 2 * Real.log (1 / delta))) *
          Real.sqrt (actualKernelVarianceAt kernel lambda (fun i => query i omega) n x)}

before.statement:
theorem mixture_all_time_crossing_probability (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ν : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (M : Θ → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ theta, Supermartingale (M theta) F μ)
    (hjoint : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable[(F n).prod mΘ]
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1))
    (hprod : ∀ n, Integrable (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1) (μ.prod ν))
    (hnonneg : ∀ theta n omega, 0 ≤ M theta n omega)
    (hinit : ∀ theta omega, M theta 0 omega = 1) (delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 < delta) :
    μ.real {omega | ∃ n, 1 / delta ≤ mixture ν M n omega} ≤ delta

    (hM : ∀ theta, Supermartingale (M theta) F μ)
    (hjoint : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable[(F n).prod mΘ]
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1))
    (hprod : ∀ n, Integrable (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1) (μ.prod ν))
    (hnonneg : ∀ theta n omega, 0 ≤ M theta n omega)
    (hinit : ∀ theta omega, M theta 0 omega = 1) (delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 < delta) :
    1 - delta ≤ μ.real {omega | ∀ n, mixture ν M n omega < 1 / delta}

    (hM : ∀ theta, Supermartingale (M theta) F μ)
    (hjoint : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable[(F n).prod mΘ]
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1))
    (hprod : ∀ n, Integrable (fun p : Ω × Θ => M p.2 n p.1) (μ.prod ν))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapePredictableNoise.actual_bounded_predictable_weight_preserves_conditional_zero_and_support
before.statement:
theorem actual_bounded_predictable_weight_preserves_conditional_zero_and_support
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (q Y : Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable[m] q)
    (hY : @Measurable Ω ℝ mΩ inferInstance Y)
    (K R : ℝ≥0) (hqbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, |q omega| ≤ K)
    (hYbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, Y omega ∈ Icc (-(R : ℝ)) R)
    (hzero : μ[Y | m] =ᵐ[μ] 0) :
    μ[q * Y | m] =ᵐ[μ] 0 ∧
      (∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, (q * Y) omega ∈ Icc (-((K * R : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) (K * R : ℝ≥0))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapePredictableNoise.actual_predictable_weighted_noise_has_the_all_time_linear_confidence_event
before.statement:
theorem actual_predictable_weighted_noise_has_the_all_time_linear_confidence_event
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ)
    (q Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F i] (q i))
    (hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F (i + 1)] (Y i))
    (K R : ℝ≥0) (hqbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, |q i omega| ≤ K)
    (hYbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, Y i omega ∈ Icc (-(R : ℝ)) R)
    (hzero : ∀ i, μ[Y i | F i] =ᵐ[μ] 0)
    (lambda delta : ℝ) (hl : 0 < lambda) (hd : 0 < delta) :
    1 - delta ≤ μ.real {omega | ∀ n,
      |partialSum (fun i => q i * Y i) n omega| < linearBoundary (K * R) lambda delta n}

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapePredictableNoise.actual_predictable_weighted_noise_has_the_derived_conditional_law
before.statement:
theorem actual_predictable_weighted_noise_has_the_derived_conditional_law
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ)
    (q Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F i] (q i))
    (hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F (i + 1)] (Y i))
    (K R : ℝ≥0) (hqbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, |q i omega| ≤ K)
    (hYbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, Y i omega ∈ Icc (-(R : ℝ)) R)
    (hzero : ∀ i, μ[Y i | F i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) :
    (∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F (i + 1)] (q i * Y i)) ∧

before.statement:
theorem actual_query_filtered_partial_sum_is_the_observed_noise_sum

    (x : D) (n : ℕ) (omega : Ω) :

      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, if query i omega = x then Y i omega else 0

before.statement:
theorem actual_all_time_predictable_weighted_noise_quadratic_boundary_probability
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ)
    (q Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F i] (q i))
    (hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F (i + 1)] (Y i)) (K R : ℝ≥0)
    (hqbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, |q i omega| ≤ K)
    (hYbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, Y i omega ∈ Icc (-(R : ℝ)) R)
    (hzero : ∀ i, μ[Y i | F i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) (lambda delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 < delta) :
    μ.real {omega | ∃ n, Real.log (1 / delta) ≤
      lambda * partialSum (fun i => q i * Y i) n omega -
        lambda ^ 2 * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * partialSum (fun i omega => q i omega ^ 2) n omega / 2} ≤ delta

before.statement:
theorem actual_predictable_weighted_noise_conditional_mgf_uses_the_actual_squared_weight
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (q Y : Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable[m] q)
    (hY : @Measurable Ω ℝ mΩ inferInstance Y) (K R : ℝ≥0)
    (hqbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, |q omega| ≤ K)
    (hYbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ, Y omega ∈ Icc (-(R : ℝ)) R)
    (hzero : μ[Y | m] =ᵐ[μ] 0) (lambda : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega => Real.exp (lambda * (q * Y) omega)) μ ∧
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂μ,
        (μ[fun w => Real.exp (lambda * (q * Y) w) | m]) omega ≤
          Real.exp (lambda ^ 2 * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * q omega ^ 2 / 2)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeQuadraticWeights.actual_quadratic_weight_process_has_initial_one_and_the_exact_step
before.statement:
theorem actual_quadratic_weight_process_has_initial_one_and_the_exact_step
    {Ω : Type*} (q Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (R : ℝ≥0) (lambda : ℝ) :
    quadraticProcess q Y R lambda 0 = 1 ∧ ∀ n omega,
      quadraticProcess q Y R lambda (n + 1) omega =
        (quadraticProcess q Y R lambda n omega *
          Real.exp (-lambda ^ 2 * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * q n omega ^ 2 / 2)) *
            Real.exp (lambda * (q n * Y n) omega)

theorem actual_closed_domain_relative_Lipschitz_regular_barrier_has_an_escaping_true_solution :
    IsClosed domain ∧ domain = {x | 0 ≤ barrier x} ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 1 barrier ∧ LipschitzWith 0 controller ∧
      LipschitzOnWith 0 field domain ∧ LocallyLipschitzOn domain field ∧
      (∀ x ∈ domain, -alpha (barrier x) ≤ fderiv ℝ barrier x (field x)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ domain, barrier x = 0 →
        fderiv ℝ barrier x ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ barrier x (field x)) ∧
      trajectory 0 = 0 ∧ (0 : ℝ) ∈ domain ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Ici 0, HasDerivWithinAt trajectory (field (trajectory t)) (Ici 0) t) ∧
      ∃ t > (0 : ℝ), trajectory t ∉ domain ∧ barrier (trajectory t) < 0

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeVectorMixture.actual_vector_projection_sums_are_the_noise_vector_and_gram_quadratic
before.statement:
theorem actual_vector_projection_sums_are_the_noise_vector_and_gram_quadratic
    {Ω : Type*} (phi : ℕ → Ω → feature → ℝ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (theta : feature → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (omega : Ω) :
    partialSum (fun i => directionalWeight phi theta i * Y i) n omega =
      theta ⬝ᵥ featureNoiseSum phi Y n omega ∧
    partialSum (fun i omega => directionalWeight phi theta i omega ^ 2) n omega =
      theta ⬝ᵥ (featureQuadraticGram phi n omega *ᵥ theta)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesLandscapeVectorMixture.actual_vector_tilt_process_is_the_noise_vector_gram_exponential
before.statement:
theorem actual_vector_tilt_process_is_the_noise_vector_gram_exponential
    {Ω : Type*} (phi : ℕ → Ω → feature → ℝ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (R : ℝ≥0) (theta : feature → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (omega : Ω) :
    vectorTiltProcess phi Y R theta n omega =
      Real.exp (theta ⬝ᵥ featureNoiseSum phi Y n omega -
        (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * (theta ⬝ᵥ (featureQuadraticGram phi n omega *ᵥ theta)) / 2)

      ∑ k, multiplier k*(-2*alpha*beta*((preactivation *ᵥ vector) k)^2+

    (lower upper : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ lower) (horder : lower ≤ upper)
    (weightLower weightUpper : I → ℝ)
    (hLower : ∀ i, (∑ j, inner ℝ (feature i) (feature j)*weightLower j)+
      lower*weightLower i=inner ℝ (feature i) target)
    (hUpper : ∀ i, (∑ j, inner ℝ (feature i) (feature j)*weightUpper j)+
      upper*weightUpper i=inner ℝ (feature i) target) :
    posteriorVariance feature target weightLower ≤ posteriorVariance feature target weightUpper

    (regularizer : ℝ) (weight : I → ℝ)
    (hsystem : ∀ i, (∑ j, inner ℝ (feature i) (feature j)*weight j)+
      regularizer*weight i=inner ℝ (feature i) target) :
    residualObjective feature target regularizer weight=posteriorVariance feature target weight

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesPosterior.residual_objective_gap
before.statement:
theorem residual_objective_gap (feature : I → H) (target : H)
    (regularizer : ℝ) (weight other : I → ℝ)
    (hsystem : ∀ i, (∑ j, inner ℝ (feature i) (feature j)*weight j)+
      regularizer*weight i=inner ℝ (feature i) target) :
    residualObjective feature target regularizer other=
      residualObjective feature target regularizer weight+
      ‖combination feature (other-weight)‖^2+
      regularizer*∑ i, (other i-weight i)^2

    (cost : X → X → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ x, oldLower x ≤ newLower x) (hu : ∀ x, newUpper x ≤ oldUpper x) :

      actualExpanders safe newUpper cost threshold ⊆ actualExpanders safe oldUpper cost threshold ∧

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesSafeOptFiniteRunOptimality.actual_finite_safeopt_run_information_budget_forces_all_later_reachable_report_optimality
before.statement:
theorem actual_finite_safeopt_run_information_budget_forces_all_later_reachable_report_optimality
    (safe : ℕ → Finset X) (bound : Finset X) (seed : Set X)
    (f : X → ℝ) (lower upper : ℕ → X → ℝ) (constant : NNReal) (threshold : ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ j, (safe j).Nonempty)
    (hmono : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → safe i ⊆ safe j) (hbound : ∀ j, safe j ⊆ bound)
    (hseed_nonempty : seed.Nonempty) (hseed : seed ⊆ (safe 0 : Set X))
    (hconfidence : ∀ j x, x ∈ bound → lower j x ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ upper j x)
    (hlower : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∀ x, lower i x ≤ lower j x)
    (hupper : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∀ x, upper j x ≤ upper i x)
    (hupdate : ∀ j, (safe (j + 1) : Set X) =
      actualExpansion (safe j : Set X) (lower (j + 1)) constant threshold)
    (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) (horizon : ℕ) (hpositive : 0 < horizon / (bound.card + 1))
    (multiplier lambda information epsilon : ℝ) (hmultiplier : 0 ≤ multiplier)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (hradius : ∀ j < horizon, actualWidth (lower j) (upper j)
      (actualFiniteQuery (safe j) (lower j) (upper j) (fun x y => constant * dist x y) threshold
        (hs j) (fun x hx => (hconfidence j x (hbound j hx)).1.trans
          (hconfidence j x (hbound j hx)).2)) ≤ 2 * multiplier * sigma j)
    (hsigma : ∀ j < horizon, (sigma j) ^ 2 ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hinformation : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range horizon,
      Real.log (1 + (sigma j) ^ 2 / lambda) ≤ 2 * information)
    (hbudget : 8 * multiplier ^ 2 * information / Real.log (1 + 1 / lambda) ≤
      ((horizon / (bound.card + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * epsilon ^ 2) :
    ∃ optimum : ℝ,
      IsGreatest (f '' actualReachableClosure f constant threshold epsilon seed) optimum ∧
      ∀ j, horizon ≤ j → optimum - f (actualFiniteReport (safe j) (lower j) (hs j)) ≤ epsilon

before.statement:

    (hseed : seed ⊆ (safe : Set X))

    (hwidth : actualWidth lower upper (actualFiniteQuery safe lower upper
      (fun x y => constant * dist x y) threshold hs
      (fun x hx => (hconfidence x hx).1.trans (hconfidence x hx).2)) ≤ epsilon)

      IsGreatest (f '' actualReachableClosure f constant threshold epsilon seed) optimum ∧
      optimum - f (actualFiniteReport safe lower hs) ≤ epsilon

    (constant : NNReal) (threshold : ℝ) (hs : safe.Nonempty)
    (hseed_nonempty : seed.Nonempty) (hseed : seed ⊆ (safe : Set X))
    (hconfidence : ∀ j x, x ∈ safe → lower j x ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ upper j x)
    (hlower : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∀ x, lower i x ≤ lower j x)
    (hupper : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∀ x, upper j x ≤ upper i x)
    (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (multiplier lambda information epsilon : ℝ) (hmultiplier : 0 ≤ multiplier)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)

      (actualFiniteQuery safe (lower j) (upper j) (fun x y => constant * dist x y) threshold hs
        (fun x hx => (hconfidence j x hx).1.trans (hconfidence j x hx).2)) ≤
          2 * multiplier * sigma j)
    (hsigma : ∀ j < N, (sigma j) ^ 2 ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hinformation : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Real.log (1 + (sigma j) ^ 2 / lambda) ≤ 2 * information)
    (hbudget : 8 * multiplier ^ 2 * information / Real.log (1 + 1 / lambda) ≤ (N : ℝ) * epsilon ^ 2)
    (hupdate : actualExpansion (safe : Set X) (lower N) constant threshold ⊆ (safe : Set X)) :

      IsGreatest (f '' actualReachableClosure f constant threshold epsilon seed) optimum ∧

    (multiplier : K → ℝ) (inputIncrement : I → ℝ) (hiddenIncrement : K → ℝ) :
    quadratic (blockCertificate inputWeight outputWeight 0 1 1 multiplier)

theorem actual_unit_network_source_energy_margin

    (firstBias : K → ℝ) (lastBias : O → ℝ) (activation : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hactivation : slopeRestricted activation 0 1)
    (multiplier : K → ℝ) (hmultiplier : ∀ coordinate,0 ≤ multiplier coordinate)
    (hcertificate : (-(blockCertificate inputWeight outputWeight 0 1 1 multiplier)).PosSemidef)
    (first second : I → ℝ) :
    2*((hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation first-hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation second) ⬝ᵥ
      (Matrix.diagonal multiplier *ᵥ (inputWeight *ᵥ (first-second)-
        (hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation first-hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation second)))) ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (first-second)‖^2-
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (oneHiddenNetwork inputWeight outputWeight firstBias lastBias activation first-
        oneHiddenNetwork inputWeight outputWeight firstBias lastBias activation second)‖^2 ∧
    0 ≤ 2*((hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation first-hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation second) ⬝ᵥ
      (Matrix.diagonal multiplier *ᵥ (inputWeight *ᵥ (first-second)-
        (hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation first-hiddenValues inputWeight firstBias activation second))))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.negative_scalar_schur_iff
before.statement:
theorem negative_scalar_schur_iff (a b c : ℝ) (hc : c < 0) :
    (∀ x y : ℝ, a*x^2+2*b*x*y+c*y^2 ≤ 0) ↔ a-b^2/c ≤ 0

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_lipsdp_feasibility_iff
before.statement:
theorem scalar_lipsdp_feasibility_iff (alpha beta w0 w1 t rho : ℝ)
    (ht : w1^2 < 2*t) :
    (∀ x y : ℝ, (-2*alpha*beta*w0^2*t-rho)*x^2+
      2*((alpha+beta)*w0*t)*x*y+(-2*t+w1^2)*y^2 ≤ 0) ↔
      scalarRho alpha beta w0 w1 t ≤ rho

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_optimal_multiplier_domain
before.statement:
theorem scalar_optimal_multiplier_domain (alpha beta w1 : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hab : alpha < beta) (hw : w1 ≠ 0) :
    w1^2 < 2*(beta*w1^2/(beta-alpha))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_optimal_rho_attained
before.statement:
theorem scalar_optimal_rho_attained (alpha beta w0 w1 : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha : alpha < beta) (hw : w1 ≠ 0) :
    scalarRho alpha beta w0 w1 (beta*w1^2/(beta-alpha))=beta^2*w0^2*w1^2

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_relu_certificate
before.statement:
theorem scalar_relu_certificate (x y : ℝ) :
    -36*x^2+24*x*y-4*y^2= -4*(3*x-y)^2

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_relu_exact_gain_necessary
before.statement:
theorem scalar_relu_exact_gain_necessary (w0 w1 bias L : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hw0 : w0 ≠ 0)
    (hgain : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      |w1*max (w0*x+bias) 0-w1*max (w0*y+bias) 0| ≤ L*|x-y|) :
    |w0*w1| ≤ L

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_relu_upper
before.statement:
theorem scalar_relu_upper (w0 w1 bias x y : ℝ) :
    |w1*max (w0*x+bias) 0-w1*max (w0*y+bias) 0| ≤ |w0*w1| * |x-y|

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_rho_gap_identity
before.statement:
theorem scalar_rho_gap_identity (alpha beta w0 w1 t : ℝ) (ht : 2*t-w1^2 ≠ 0) :
    scalarRho alpha beta w0 w1 t-beta^2*w0^2*w1^2=
      w0^2*((beta-alpha)*t-beta*w1^2)^2/(2*t-w1^2)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesScalarSDP.scalar_rho_global_lower
before.statement:
theorem scalar_rho_global_lower (alpha beta w0 w1 t : ℝ) (ht : w1^2 < 2*t) :
    beta^2*w0^2*w1^2 ≤ scalarRho alpha beta w0 w1 t

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesSemidefiniteSchur.actual_range_condition_gives_the_true_block_square_completion
before.statement:
theorem actual_range_condition_gives_the_true_block_square_completion
    (A : Matrix Left Left ℝ) (B : Matrix Left Right ℝ) (D : Matrix Right Right ℝ)
    (hsymmetric : D.IsHermitian)
    (hrange : B*actualPseudoinverse D hsymmetric*D=B) :
    actualSymmetricBlock A B D=
      (actualCompletionMap B (actualPseudoinverse D hsymmetric))ᵀ*
        Matrix.fromBlocks (A-B*actualPseudoinverse D hsymmetric*Bᵀ) 0 0 D*
        actualCompletionMap B (actualPseudoinverse D hsymmetric)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhChords.actual_local_tanh_chord_has_the_literal_positive_lower_and_upper_bound
before.statement:
theorem actual_local_tanh_chord_has_the_literal_positive_lower_and_upper_bound
    (radius first second : ℝ) (hfirst : |first| ≤ radius)

    0 < 1 - (Real.tanh radius) ^ 2 ∧
    1 - (Real.tanh radius) ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.tanh first - Real.tanh second) / (first - second) ∧
    (Real.tanh first - Real.tanh second) / (first - second) ≤ 1

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhOffsetQC.actual_source_endpoint_lower_is_the_literal_minimum
before.statement:

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhOffsetQC.actual_source_left_endpoint_fraction_is_the_same_chord
before.statement:

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhRefinement.actual_local_origin_tanh_graph_satisfies_the_tighter_secant_qc

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhRefinement.actual_local_tanh_increments_satisfy_the_literal_refined_qc

theorem actual_local_tanh_increments_satisfy_the_literal_refined_qc

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhRefinement.actual_offset_tanh_uses_a_true_local_incremental_qc

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhRefinement.actual_smaller_interval_makes_the_source_containment_condition_stricter

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_chords_near_the_positive_endpoint_approach_the_lower_derivative_bound

    (radius : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun point : ℝ => (Real.tanh point-Real.tanh radius)/(point-radius))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_chords_near_zero_approach_the_upper_derivative_bound

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_origin_ratio_approaches_the_upper_endpoint_one_at_zero

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_origin_ratio_has_the_printed_negative_derivative

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_origin_ratio_lower_bound_is_attained_and_greatest

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_source_h_is_positive_for_every_positive_input

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTanhSharpBounds.actual_tanh_origin_secant_strictly_decreases_on_positive_inputs

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.finite_failure_union

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.independent_success_lower

    (hindependent : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepSet success μ)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hbound : ∀ i, p ≤ μ.real (success i)) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.independent_success_product

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.multiple_constraint_witnesses

theorem multiple_constraint_witnesses {X ι : Type*}

    (candidate : X)
    (hconfidence : ∀ i z, lower i z ≤ f i z)
    (hlip : ∀ i z, f i z-L i*distance candidate z ≤ f i candidate)
    (hwitness : ∀ i, ∃ z, 0 ≤ lower i z-L i*distance candidate z) :
    ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i candidate

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.positive_block_schur
before.statement:
theorem positive_block_schur {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (D : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) [Invertible A] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef ↔
      (D-B.conjTranspose*A⁻¹*B).PosSemidef

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.positive_block_schur_lower

theorem positive_block_schur_lower {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

    (hD : D.PosDef) [Invertible D] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B B.conjTranspose D).PosSemidef ↔
      (A-B*D⁻¹*B.conjTranspose).PosSemidef

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteModulesTheory.sampling_grid_margin

    (grid : Set X) (coverRadius margin : ℝ)
    (hgrid : ∀ z ∈ grid, margin ≤ f z)
    (hcover : ∀ x, ∃ z ∈ grid, dist x z ≤ coverRadius)
    (hbudget : L*coverRadius ≤ margin) : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x

theorem actual_strict_infinity_radius_certifies_every_source_logit_map
    {O : Type*} [Fintype O] [DecidableEq O]
    (logits : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → O → ℝ)
    (winner : O) (first second : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hcompetitors : (Finset.univ.erase winner).Nonempty)
    (hmargin : actualLogitMargin logits winner first (Finset.univ.erase winner) hcompetitors=(0.6:ℝ))
    (hlogits : ∀ x y,‖WithLp.toLp 2 (logits x-logits y)‖ ≤ (2:ℝ)*‖x-y‖)
    (hdelta : ‖WithLp.ofLp (first-second)‖ < infinityRadius) :
    ∀ other,other≠winner → logits second other<logits second winner

theorem actual_affine_LFT_equations {nx nu n1 n2 : ℕ} (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (W0 : Matrix (Fin n1) (Fin nx) ℝ) (W1 : Matrix (Fin n2) (Fin n1) ℝ)
    (W2 : Matrix (Fin nu) (Fin n2) ℝ) (b0 : Fin n1 → ℝ) (b1 : Fin n2 → ℝ)
    (b2 : Fin nu → ℝ) (x : State nx) :
    controller phi W0 W1 W2 b0 b1 b2 x =
      (Nux nu nx).mulVec x+(Nuw W2).mulVec
        (Sum.elim (w1 phi W0 b0 x) (w2 phi W0 W1 b0 b1 x))+b2 ∧
    Sum.elim (v1 W0 b0 x) (v2 phi W0 W1 b0 b1 x)=
      (Nvx W0).mulVec x+(Nvw W1).mulVec
        (Sum.elim (w1 phi W0 b0 x) (w2 phi W0 W1 b0 b1 x))+Sum.elim b0 b1

    {nx nu n1 n2 : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin nx) (Fin nx) ℝ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin nx) (Fin nu) ℝ) (W0 : Matrix (Fin n1) (Fin nx) ℝ)
    (W1 : Matrix (Fin n2) (Fin n1) ℝ) (W2 : Matrix (Fin nu) (Fin n2) ℝ)
    (b0 : Fin n1 → ℝ) (b1 : Fin n2 → ℝ) (b2 : Fin nu → ℝ)
    (x xs : State nx) (first firsts : Fin n1 → ℝ) (second seconds : Fin n2 → ℝ)
    (heq : xs=A.mulVec xs+B.mulVec (W2.mulVec seconds+b2)) :
    ((A.mulVec x+B.mulVec (W2.mulVec second+b2))-xs)=
      A.mulVec (x-xs)+B.mulVec (W2.mulVec (second-seconds)) ∧
    (W0.mulVec x+b0)-(W0.mulVec xs+b0)=W0.mulVec (x-xs) ∧
    (W1.mulVec first+b1)-(W1.mulVec firsts+b1)=W1.mulVec (first-firsts) ∧

    {X U : Type*} (ambient : Set X) (admissible : Set U) (failure : Set X)
    (flow : X → U → ℝ → X) :
    ambient \ viable admissible failure flow =
      {x ∈ ambient | ∀ u ∈ admissible, ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ flow x u t ∈ failure}

    {X U : Type*} (ambient : Set X) (admissible : Set U) (failure : Set X)
    (flow : X → U → ℝ → X) (x : X) :
    (x ∈ viable admissible failure flow ↔
      ∃ u ∈ admissible, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → flow x u t ∉ failure) ∧
    (x ∈ ambient \ viable admissible failure flow ↔
      x ∈ ambient ∧ ∀ u ∈ admissible, ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ flow x u t ∈ failure)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_upper_successor_table

theorem actual_every_lower_action_falls (s : State) (a : Action)

    ∀ n, start ≤ n → states n = .sink

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_every_unviable_grid_path_fails_by_two
before.statement:
theorem actual_every_unviable_grid_path_fails_by_two
    (states : ℕ → State) (actions : ℕ → Action)
    (hzero : states 0 ∈ unviableStates)
    (hlegal : ∀ n, available (states n) (actions n))
    (hstep : ∀ n, states (n + 1) = step (states n) (actions n)) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_grid_failure_is_visited_at_exactly_one_time

theorem actual_grid_failure_is_visited_at_exactly_one_time

    (hhit : states failure = .failure) :
    ∀ n, states n = .failure ↔ n = failure

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_every_upper_path_has_the_two_failure_patterns
before.statement:
theorem actual_every_upper_path_has_the_two_failure_patterns
    (states : ℕ → State) (actions : ℕ → Action) (h : Realizes states actions) :
    (actions 0 = .down ∧ states 1 = .failure ∧ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → states n = .sink) ∨
    (actions 0 ≠ .down ∧
      (states 1 = lowerLeft ∨ states 1 = lowerCenter ∨ states 1 = lowerRight) ∧
      states 2 = .failure ∧ ∀ n, 3 ≤ n → states n = .sink)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_three_term_counting_sums
before.statement:
theorem actual_three_term_counting_sums
    (discount cost goalReward : ℝ) (states : ℕ → State)
    (htail : ∀ n, 3 ≤ n → states n = .sink) :
    discountedReward discount cost goalReward states =
      reward cost goalReward (states 0) + discount * reward cost goalReward (states 1) +
        discount ^ 2 * reward cost goalReward (states 2) ∧
    discountedRisk discount states =
      failureCharge (states 0) + discount * failureCharge (states 1) +
        discount ^ 2 * failureCharge (states 2)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_every_upper_path_return_is_fast_or_slow
before.statement:
theorem actual_every_upper_path_return_is_fast_or_slow
    (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) (states : ℕ → State) (actions : ℕ → Action)
    (h : Realizes states actions) :
    penalizedReturn discount cost goalReward penalty states = -cost - discount * penalty ∨
    penalizedReturn discount cost goalReward penalty states =
      -cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_every_feedback_realizes_its_path
before.statement:
theorem actual_every_feedback_realizes_its_path (controller : Feedback) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_down_feedback_attains_fast
before.statement:
theorem actual_down_feedback_attains_fast (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_stay_feedback_attains_slow
before.statement:
theorem actual_stay_feedback_attains_slow (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) :
    controllerReturn discount cost goalReward penalty stayFeedback =
      -cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_controller_return_set_is_exactly_the_two_source_values
before.statement:
theorem actual_controller_return_set_is_exactly_the_two_source_values
    (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) :
    Set.range (controllerReturn discount cost goalReward penalty) =
      {-cost - discount * penalty, -cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty}

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_controller_supremum_is_attained_source_max
before.statement:
theorem actual_controller_supremum_is_attained_source_max
    (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) :
    actualUpperValue discount cost goalReward penalty =
      max (-cost - discount * penalty) (-cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_stopped_reward_and_negative_bound_difference
before.statement:
theorem actual_stopped_reward_and_negative_bound_difference (discount cost penalty : ℝ) :
    (-cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty) -
      (-cost * (1 + discount + discount ^ 2) - penalty * discount ^ 2) = discount ^ 2 * cost ∧
    -cost + discount * (-cost - discount * penalty) =
      -cost - discount * cost - discount ^ 2 * penalty

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_slope_value_has_the_source_bound
before.statement:
theorem actual_slope_value_has_the_source_bound (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ cost) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty) :
    actualUpperValue discount cost goalReward penalty ≤ -penalty * discount ^ 2

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_slow_fall_strictly_wins_exactly_when_printed
before.statement:
theorem actual_slow_fall_strictly_wins_exactly_when_printed
    (discount cost goalReward penalty : ℝ) (hd : 0 < discount) :
    controllerReturn discount cost goalReward penalty downFeedback <
      controllerReturn discount cost goalReward penalty stayFeedback ↔ cost < penalty * (1 - discount)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_nonnegative_reward_constant
before.statement:
theorem actual_nonnegative_reward_constant (cost : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ cost) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_negative_reward_bound_is_below_the_value
before.statement:
theorem actual_negative_reward_bound_is_below_the_value

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.stopped_discounted_reward_is_finite_prefix
before.statement:
theorem stopped_discounted_reward_is_finite_prefix (discount : ℝ) (rewards : ℕ → ℝ)
    (failure : ℕ) (hz : ∀ n, failure < n → rewards n = 0) :
    (∑' n, discount ^ n * rewards n) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (failure + 1), discount ^ n * rewards n

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_finite_support_counting_integral_is_its_sum
before.statement:
theorem actual_finite_support_counting_integral_is_its_sum

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_stopped_counting_integral_is_the_printed_finite_reward_sum
before.statement:
theorem actual_stopped_counting_integral_is_the_printed_finite_reward_sum

    (hz : ∀ n, failure < n → rewards n = 0) :
    Integrable (fun n => discount ^ n * rewards n) Measure.count ∧
      (∫ n : ℕ, discount ^ n * rewards n ∂Measure.count) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (failure + 1), discount ^ n * rewards n

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.single_failure_discounted_risk_is_arrival_weight
before.statement:
theorem single_failure_discounted_risk_is_arrival_weight (discount : ℝ) (failure : ℕ) :

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_single_failure_counting_integral_is_arrival_weight
before.statement:
theorem actual_single_failure_counting_integral_is_arrival_weight

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_grid_arrival_derives_the_counting_reward_and_risk
before.statement:
theorem actual_grid_arrival_derives_the_counting_reward_and_risk
    (discount cost goalReward : ℝ) (states : ℕ → State) (actions : ℕ → Action)
    (failure : ℕ) (hstep : ∀ n, states (n + 1) = step (states n) (actions n))
    (hhit : states failure = .failure) :
    discountedReward discount cost goalReward states =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (failure + 1), discount ^ n * reward cost goalReward (states n) ∧

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.nonnegative_reward_bound_allows_horizon_extension
before.statement:
theorem nonnegative_reward_bound_allows_horizon_extension
    (discount bound : ℝ) (failure horizon : ℕ) (hd : 0 ≤ discount)
    (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (ht : failure ≤ horizon) :
    bound * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (failure + 1), discount ^ n) ≤
      bound * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (horizon + 1), discount ^ n)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.negative_reward_bound_reverses_horizon_extension
before.statement:
theorem negative_reward_bound_reverses_horizon_extension
    (discount bound : ℝ) (failure horizon : ℕ) (hd : 0 ≤ discount)
    (hb : bound ≤ 0) (ht : failure ≤ horizon) :
    bound * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (horizon + 1), discount ^ n) ≤
      bound * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (failure + 1), discount ^ n)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.counting_sum_doomed_return_bound
before.statement:
theorem counting_sum_doomed_return_bound (discount bound penalty : ℝ)
    (rewards : ℕ → ℝ) (failure horizon : ℕ) (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty) (ht : failure ≤ horizon)
    (hr : ∀ n < failure + 1, rewards n ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ n, failure < n → rewards n = 0) :
    (∑' n, discount ^ n * rewards n) -
      penalty * (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if n = failure then 1 else 0 : ℝ)) ≤
      bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) - penalty * discount ^ horizon

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_unviability_is_forward_invariant_before_failure

theorem actual_every_visited_prefailure_state_is_unviable

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_unviable_trajectory_counting_sum_bound
before.statement:
theorem actual_unviable_trajectory_counting_sum_bound
    {S A : Type*} (dynamics : S → A → S) (allowed : S → A → Prop)
    (safe kernel failureStates : Set S)
    (hk : IsGreatest {Y : Set S | Y ⊆ safe ∧
      Y ⊆ CompleteFoundationsGraphViability.controlledPre dynamics allowed Y} kernel)
    (states : ℕ → S) (actions : ℕ → A) (r : S → A → ℝ)
    (discount bound penalty : ℝ) (failure horizon : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1) (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (ht : failure ≤ horizon) (hzero : states 0 ∉ kernel)
    (hsafe : ∀ n < failure, states n ∈ safe)
    (hallowed : ∀ n, allowed (states n) (actions n))
    (hstep : ∀ n, states (n + 1) = dynamics (states n) (actions n))
    (hr : ∀ x ∉ kernel, ∀ a, allowed x a → r x a ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ n, failure < n → r (states n) (actions n) = 0)
    (hfailure : ∀ n, states n ∈ failureStates ↔ n = failure) :
    (∑' n, discount ^ n * r (states n) (actions n)) -
      penalty * (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if states n ∈ failureStates then 1 else 0 : ℝ)) ≤
      bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) - penalty * discount ^ horizon

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.both_controller_and_state_suprema_preserve_counting_sum_bound
before.statement:
theorem both_controller_and_state_suprema_preserve_counting_sum_bound
    {X Controller : Type*} [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Controller]
    (discount bound penalty : ℝ) (rewards : X → Controller → ℕ → ℝ)
    (failure : X → Controller → ℕ) (horizon : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1) (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (ht : ∀ x u, failure x u ≤ horizon)
    (hr : ∀ x u n, n < failure x u + 1 → rewards x u n ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ x u n, failure x u < n → rewards x u n = 0) :
    sSup (Set.range (fun x => sSup (Set.range (fun u =>
      (∑' n, discount ^ n * rewards x u n) - penalty *
        (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if n = failure x u then 1 else 0 : ℝ)))))) ≤
      bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) - penalty * discount ^ horizon

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.source_extended_outer_supremum_preserves_the_uniform_doomed_bound
before.statement:
theorem source_extended_outer_supremum_preserves_the_uniform_doomed_bound
    {X Controller : Type*} [Nonempty Controller]
    (discount bound penalty : ℝ) (rewards : X → Controller → ℕ → ℝ)
    (failure : X → Controller → ℕ) (horizon : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1) (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (ht : ∀ x u, failure x u ≤ horizon)
    (hr : ∀ x u n, n < failure x u + 1 → rewards x u n ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ x u n, failure x u < n → rewards x u n = 0) :
    sSup (Set.range (fun x => ((sSup (Set.range (fun u =>
      (∑' n, discount ^ n * rewards x u n) - penalty *
        (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if n = failure x u then 1 else 0 : ℝ)))) : ℝ) : EReal))) ≤
      ((bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) -
        penalty * discount ^ horizon : ℝ) : EReal)

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.actual_reward_supremum_bounds_each_physical_unviable_state_action
before.statement:
theorem actual_reward_supremum_bounds_each_physical_unviable_state_action
    {S A : Type*} (physical kernel : Set S) (r : S → A → ℝ)
    (hbounded : BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : {s : S // s ∈ physical ∧ s ∉ kernel} × A => r q.1.val q.2)))

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.source_physical_unviable_trajectory_counting_sum_bound
before.statement:
theorem source_physical_unviable_trajectory_counting_sum_bound
    {S A : Type*} (dynamics : S → A → S) (allowed : S → A → Prop)
    (physical safe kernel failureStates : Set S)
    (hk : IsGreatest {Y : Set S | Y ⊆ safe ∧
      Y ⊆ CompleteFoundationsGraphViability.controlledPre dynamics allowed Y} kernel)
    (states : ℕ → S) (actions : ℕ → A) (r : S → A → ℝ)
    (discount bound penalty : ℝ) (failure horizon : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1) (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (ht : failure ≤ horizon) (hzero : states 0 ∉ kernel)
    (hphysical : ∀ n ≤ failure, states n ∈ physical)
    (hsafe : ∀ n < failure, states n ∈ safe)
    (hallowed : ∀ n, allowed (states n) (actions n))
    (hstep : ∀ n, states (n + 1) = dynamics (states n) (actions n))
    (hbounded : BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : {s : S // s ∈ physical ∧ s ∉ kernel} × A => r q.1.val q.2)))
    (hsup : sSup (Set.range (fun q : {s : S // s ∈ physical ∧ s ∉ kernel} × A => r q.1.val q.2)) ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ n, failure < n → r (states n) (actions n) = 0)
    (hfailure : ∀ n, states n ∈ failureStates ↔ n = failure) :
    (∑' n, discount ^ n * r (states n) (actions n)) -
      penalty * (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if states n ∈ failureStates then 1 else 0 : ℝ)) ≤
      bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) - penalty * discount ^ horizon

before.name: SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedExplorerSlope27.source_actual_state_and_controller_suprema_have_the_uniform_bound
before.statement:
theorem source_actual_state_and_controller_suprema_have_the_uniform_bound
    {S A X Controller : Type*} [Nonempty Controller]
    (dynamics : S → A → S) (allowed : S → A → Prop)
    (physical safe kernel failureStates : Set S)
    (hk : IsGreatest {Y : Set S | Y ⊆ safe ∧
      Y ⊆ CompleteFoundationsGraphViability.controlledPre dynamics allowed Y} kernel)
    (states : X → Controller → ℕ → S) (actions : X → Controller → ℕ → A)
    (r : S → A → ℝ) (failure : X → Controller → ℕ)
    (discount bound penalty : ℝ) (horizon : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ discount) (hd1 : discount < 1) (hb : 0 ≤ bound) (hp : 0 ≤ penalty)
    (ht : ∀ x u, failure x u ≤ horizon)
    (hzero : ∀ x u, states x u 0 ∉ kernel)
    (hphysical : ∀ x u n, n ≤ failure x u → states x u n ∈ physical)
    (hsafe : ∀ x u n, n < failure x u → states x u n ∈ safe)
    (hallowed : ∀ x u n, allowed (states x u n) (actions x u n))
    (hstep : ∀ x u n, states x u (n + 1) = dynamics (states x u n) (actions x u n))
    (hbounded : BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : {s : S // s ∈ physical ∧ s ∉ kernel} × A => r q.1.val q.2)))
    (hsup : sSup (Set.range (fun q : {s : S // s ∈ physical ∧ s ∉ kernel} × A => r q.1.val q.2)) ≤ bound)
    (hz : ∀ x u n, failure x u < n → r (states x u n) (actions x u n) = 0)
    (hfailure : ∀ x u n, states x u n ∈ failureStates ↔ n = failure x u) :
    sSup (Set.range (fun x => ((sSup (Set.range (fun u =>
      (∑' n, discount ^ n * r (states x u n) (actions x u n)) - penalty *
        (∑' n : ℕ, discount ^ n * (if states x u n ∈ failureStates then 1 else 0 : ℝ)))) : ℝ) : EReal))) ≤
      ((bound * (1 - discount ^ (horizon + 1)) / (1 - discount) -
        penalty * discount ^ horizon : ℝ) : EReal)
